pro_course_detail.title: English A1 - C2
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner to advanced learners of all ages are welcome! 

The lessons are adapted to your needs and interests. I use a variety of audiovisual materials and incorporate worksheets and homework that are specific for each student according to their needs and wants. If you need to refine your composition skills for work purposes, then the lessons will focus on reading and writing skills in accordance with writing conventions in a professional setting. If you would like to feel more confident speaking to native speakers, then the lessons will revolve around conversational topics along with speaking and listening skills. If you simply want to improve your overall proficiency, then we will take a holistic approach and integrate all the skills into the lessons and post-lesson practice (homework!). In summary, the language learning plan is a collaborative process and is adapted according to the results that you wish to attain!

The first lesson / trial lesson serves as a diagnostic tool to help identify language gaps, specify preferences and interests, and discuss goals and how to best approach the lessons so that you may receive a more personalized learning experience that will help you achieve them. 

Lesson packages include a personalized learning plan, learning materials, writing assessments and feedback outside of lesson time, and a free speaking assessment after every 5 lessons. Since you've read up to this point, it's evident that you are serious about improving your language skills. So, what are you waiting for? Book a trial lesson today and let's talk about how we can bring you closer to your goals!

pro_course_detail.description:
Learn to speak and understand American Standard English from a native-born Michigander!  Michigan English is the most understandable dialect.  You too can learn to speak fluently in this dialect - also known as "Broadcast English" through this application of the Phonics International course.

This comprehensive course will acquaint you with the 44+ sounds used in English and show you how to reproduce them reliably and confidently.  You'll also find that you can more easily understand English language movies and TV shows - without turning on the captions!

Note:  30 minute sessions are recommended!

pro_course_detail.title: [English] Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Join me for an hour-long conversation practice lesson tailored to your interests and goals! In this lesson, we will focus on topics that matter to you, whether it’s travel, popular culture, business, or food!

Throughout the lesson, you'll have the opportunity to:

    - Practice speaking in a relaxed and supportive environment.
    - Expand your vocabulary and improve your pronunciation.
    - Gain confidence in your conversational skills through guided discussions.
    - Receive personalized feedback to help you progress.

No matter your language level, this lesson is designed to improve your fluency and break through that language barrier. Feel free to reach out and book your session!

pro_course_detail.title: [English] Pronunciation and Speaking Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to improve your English pronunciation and speak more clearly? In this one-hour coaching session, we’ll try to focus on helping you sound more natural and confident in your English. Whether you want to refine your accent or work on those pesky "r" sounds that most native speakers tend to omit completely, I'm here to help!

We’ll work on:

    - Pronunciation tips to help you sound more fluent.
    - Reducing your accent while keeping your unique voice.
    - Stress, intonation, and sentence cadence.
    - I'll provide real-time feedback and corrections.

Let’s polish your speaking skills together, at a pace that suits you!

pro_course_detail.title: [English] Grammar & Language Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
Ready to sharpen your grammar? This hour-long, textbook-guided lesson is perfect for learners of all levels who want a solid understanding of English grammar. We'll identify the key areas where you need to improve, and dive into structured exercises that target them.

In this session, you’ll:

    - Follow a clear, step-by-step approach using a textbook. (My preference is "English Grammar in Use", but I'm happy to use anything you suggest)
    - Focus on grammar rules, sentence structure, and proper usage.
    - Practice with real examples and exercises.
    - Get personalised feedback.

Whether you’re starting from scratch or are looking to advance to the next level, this lesson will, without a doubt, be useful!
